description: This Java source file defines the CardStreamFragment class, which manages a stream of card views within an Android application. It handles adding, removing, showing, hiding, and dismissing cards, as well as saving and restoring state.

classes.name: CardStreamFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages a dynamic stream of card views, supporting show/hide, dismiss, and state restoration.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout and initializes the card stream layout, setting up the dismiss listener.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a card to the hidden cards collection if not already present.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds and optionally shows a card.

methods.name: removeCard
methods.description: Removes a card by its tag from visible or hidden collections and from layout if visible.

methods.name: showCard
methods.description: Shows a hidden card, making it visible and dismissible if specified.

methods.name: showCard
methods.description: Overloaded; shows a card with dismissible default set to true.

methods.name: hideCard
methods.description: Hides a visible card, moving it to hidden collection.

methods.name: dismissCard
methods.description: Marks a visible, dismissible card as dismissed, moving it to hidden collection.

methods.name: isCardVisible
methods.description: Checks if a card is currently visible.

methods.name: isCardDismissible
methods.description: Checks if a card is dismissible.

methods.name: getCard
methods.description: Retrieves a card by its tag from visible or hidden collections.

methods.name: setFirstVisibleCard
methods.description: Scrolls the view to show the specified card.

methods.name: getVisibleCardCount
methods.description: Returns the number of visible cards.

methods.name: getVisibleCards
methods.description: Returns a collection of all visible cards.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores the card stream state from a saved state object.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current card stream state.

methods.name: cloneCards
methods.description: Creates shallow clones of a collection of cards.
